hero.title: Sharper connections for cross-border business.
hero.body: Plexus helps chambers, trade bodies and event organizers launch branded business-matching portals that turn member profiles into relevant introductions, meetings and deals.

problem.title: Cross-border B2B matching breaks when the process lives in spreadsheets.
problem.body: Profiles arrive in different formats. Shortlists are manual. Meeting follow-up disappears after the event. Plexus creates one shared operating layer for structured profiles, AI-assisted matching and measurable outcomes.
points: Clean business profiles across markets and languages.
AI-assisted shortlists that still keep organizers in control.
Meeting, signing and follow-up workflows in one place.

how.title: How it works
how.body: A simple path from profile creation to meaningful commercial follow-through.

steps.title: Create profile
steps.body: Businesses share sector, capabilities, goals and preferred partner criteria.

steps.title: Get matched
steps.body: Plexus ranks likely-fit opportunities and gives organizers a clear shortlist to review.

steps.title: Connect & deal
steps.body: Participants meet, track next steps and move qualified opportunities toward agreements.

portals.title: Three portals, one platform.
portals.body: Plexus supports the full white-label operating model without splitting the experience across tools.

items.body: A simple portal for profiles, matches, meetings and deal follow-up.

cta.title: Bring Plexus to your members.
cta.body: Launch a branded matching portal for your business community, or join through a participating vendor portal.

for-vendors.title: White-label B2B matching for vendors.
for-vendors.body: Give your chamber, association or event community a branded portal for member profiles, AI-assisted matching, meetings and measurable commercial outcomes.
points: Launch with your brand and member language.
Review and approve matches before participants see them.
Track meetings, signing progress and post-event reporting.

for-businesses.title: Find better-fit partners without the networking noise.
for-businesses.body: Plexus gives business owners a guided way to create a profile, receive relevant matches and move introductions into meetings and deals.

how-it-works.title: From profile to partner shortlist.
how-it-works.body: Plexus turns business data into a clear matching workflow: profile creation, AI-assisted ranking, organizer review and participant follow-through.
points: Score fit across sectors, goals and readiness.
